instructions.title: Your request for a hearing: before you file (do not file this page)
lines: This file has the Verified Request for a Hearing (PO-0107) with your answers printed on it. ReadyFile struck through the words that do not apply, as the form asks.
Sign and date it by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury.
Print 3 copies, unless the clerk tells you otherwise: one for the court, one for the other person, and one for you.
File it with the clerk of the court that issued the order. There is no fee.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
